title: Renewable Survival
description: Makes All Items Renewable. Adds crafting or mob drops.
body:
This data pack makes all items in Minecraft infinite, whether deep slate or diamonds. This pack also adds mob spawners to make it easier for you to farm every item. 

Note: This pack was just released and might have some bugs or issues. If you find any, please comment on them.

Mob Loot Changes :

Allays : Amethyst crystals

Armealado : Armalado scuet

Axolotol : Slime Ball & Fish

Bat : Phantom Membrain

Bee : Honeycomb

Camal : Catus

Creaking : Resin

Enderdragon : Leather, Dragon Breath, Dragon Head, Elitra, Diamond, Phantom Membranen, Chorus         
Fruit, Chorus Flower, Gold Ingot, Fire Charge, & Blase Poeder.

Endermite : Ender Perel

Fox : Sweet Berries & Glow Berries

Frog : Slime Ball

Goat : Leather & Mutton

Ocelot : String

Piglin Brute : Rotten Flesh & Gold Ingot

Snifer : Moss & Flower Seeds

Vex : Feather & Gaspt Tear

Villager : Emerald

Warden : Echo Shards & Disk Fragments

Wold : Bone

 Crafting Recipies

 
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35d6330e20dc0b882eb7da5be92815d3f1c698fc_0.webp)

This smithing recipe requires stone, deep slate, or nether rack with the block version of the ore. Neather gold is crafted using an ingot, and all stone and deep slate versions of iron gold and copper are made using raw copper blocks.


![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8dd25fd5d2dc951580e5ea9fc730e536b322372c.png)

This stonecutting recipe allows you to cut any ingot into its raw version. This works with iron copper and gold ingots.


![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5405b1260b8a09ff436452688a1c564aefb84aa.png)

All mossy variants of blocks are now craftable using moss and that stone version.


![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5a2f4b24f768073d10d1674e3f43043741d296d.png)

Craft mob spawners using heavy core, iron bars, chains, and iron blocks. You need to craft the spawn egg to add to the spawners.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7de6666ad35294efdf1bd8f1d6c8a44c1834e64d.png)

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd55295aa94fabb55d0263096500682ee4fe9bcb.png)

Craft spawn eggs using a sniffer egg and the designated item for each mob.

Stonecut amethyst blocks into budding amethyst.

Dupe Heart of the sea in crafting table using water and kelp.

Craft enchanted golden apples using 2 blase powder, 6 gold blocks and one normal golden apple.

Craft horse armor of all variants using 1 leather and resource of the horse armor.

Craft deepslate using 4 stone.

Craft tuff using cobblestone and deepslate.

Craft calcite using bone block and cobblestone.

Craft nametag using an iron nugget and 2 paper.

Craft saddle using 2 iron ingots 1 string and 3 leather.

Craft nether rack using stone and neather wart.

  Custom Items:

Adds an item that when placed on top of a spawner, gives you the spawner. As silk touching spawners in 1.21.4 is not possible. You will not be able get back your spawn egg. This does not give XP. This is crafted using 4 ores and an iron pickaxe. 

  Other:
Ablity to use trile chamber vaults infinatly.
